notes:
Top-line: enterprise retail platform with heavy peak season traffic (Black Friday style spikes). Evaluating Redwood Dedicated + private control plane. Primary negotiation lens is SLA (uptime, credits, maintenance), plus reserved GPU planning for predictable throughput.

Key requirements / asks from Blue Archer: 
- Throughput: sustain 7000 inference tokens/sec (mixed short chat + rerank traffic) with tail latencies under 120ms p50 and 350ms p95 for chat endpoints.
- Latency SLO: client asking for p95 < 300ms for conversational model, p95 < 150ms for embedding/rerank routes.
- Reserved capacity: wants planning for 12 H100-class GPUs (or equivalent) across 2 AZs with burst pool of 4 GPUs for campaign spikes.
- Uptime: legal pushes 99.99% for customer-facing routes; infra team willing to accept 99.95% with strong credits and multi-AZ redundancy.
- Credit schedule: client proposed 10% monthly credit for <99.99% to 99.95%, 25% for <99.95% to 99.0%, and 50% for <99.0%. Redwood proposed counter: 5% for 99.9-99.95%, 15% for 99.0-99.9%, 40% for <99.0% with carveouts for scheduled maintenance and force majeure.
- Maintenance windows: Blue Archer requires maintenance outside 09:00-21:00 local business hours; they want single 2-hour monthly maintenance window and explicit notice 14 days prior. Redwood prefers rolling per-AZ updates with max 1 hour per AZ monthly and 72-hour notice for planned major upgrades.
- Support response times: Blue Archer expects P1 on-call 15 min ack, P2 1 hour, P3 24 hours. Redwood's enterprise SLA draft: P1 30 minute ack, P2 2 hours, P3 24 hours; SE to propose escalation bridge and a discounted premium 24/7 pager option.
- Security: mandatory SSO/SAML + SOC2 + audit logs retention 7 years for transaction traces; on-prem KMS integration timeline a gating item for go-live.

Sales/SE notes: 
- Customer wants explicit throughput guarantees tied to reserved GPU counts and a deterministic capacity plan for peak-campaign dates. Recommended: propose a capacity runbook with exact card types, per-AZ replication, and a schedule for pre-signed capacity increase windows (2x burst for 72 hours with 72h notice).
- Proposal v3 (drive) includes cost model for reserved 12 GPUs + monthly burst budget. Legal redlines attached.
- Client quote: "we can't absorb unpredictable downtime during promotions — uptime and credits have to be ironclad."

Decision criteria: predictable unit cost during peaks, clear SLA credit mechanics, demonstrable multi-AZ failover for in-flight sessions, and KMS/HSM integration before go-live.

Next tacticals: SE to model request/response latency distribution and provide per-route p95 cost impact for 120/300/350ms SLOs (deliver by 2026-03-15). Finance to prepare final ARR quote once SLA terms agreed.
